name: mxxssm
description: MXXSSM - modern Spring Boot + Vue 3 monolith

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "mvn -f backend/pom.xml spring-boot:run" "pnpm --dir frontend dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --dir frontend build && mvn -f backend/pom.xml clean package
scripts.test: mvn -f backend/pom.xml test && pnpm --dir frontend test
